body.name: Lag-sum and boundary covariance objects
body.construction: \(C_{T,h}(x)=\sum_{t=1}^{T-h}x_tx_{t+h}\) for \(1\le h\le d\), \(M_L=\mathbb E[C_L(W)C_L(W)^{\top}]\) under one random affine Boolean block \(W\), \(H_d=\operatorname{Diag}(1,\ldots,d)\), and \((D_q)_{\ell,h}=q_{\ell-h}\mathbf 1\{\ell\ge h\}+q_{\ell+h}\mathbf 1\{\ell+h<K\}\).
